findings.claim: The hardcoded-secret failure inventory is internally inconsistent and will cause downstream remediation to target the wrong number of matches.
findings.evidence: The observed inventory says `no-hardcoded-secrets | Twenty historical pattern matches`, but the later classification totals 25: `Five tracked historical review packets contain two command-option-like matches each` (10), `A tracked integration inventory has a provider-token-pattern substring` (1), `docker/AGENTS.md has two command-syntax matches` (2), and `Twelve historical matches in the prior child's evidence files are absent` (12).
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the secret-match count and enumerate the exact original failed-check locations/match counts so Analyze and Plan can adjudicate every match exactly once.
